historical_archive.description: Acquire the explicitly reviewed pinned historical CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 archive. Does not represent World Bank observation data or a current census.

html_context.description: Acquire OFCA-authored Hong Kong named-system entries from HTML prose after robots and noncommercial terms checks. No route/fault inference.

infrastructure.description: Leave null until an actual official reusable World Bank snapshot exists. Never fill with generated observations.

source_url.description: Official World Bank source, not an unofficial mirror

snapshot_date.description: Actual ISO observation/snapshot date, or empty if not established. NOT metadata update date.

field_map.description: Canonical field to actual source-column mapping; omit only if source uses canonical names

reuse_confirmed.description: Confirm only with actual permission/license evidence, not an assumption

redistribution_confirmed.description: Publication rights for these records must actually be established

coordinate_precision.description: Source precision statement or explicitly unknown

region_selection.description: Acquire all officially listed GFW EEZ context regions without outcome-based selection; no fabricated geometry or high-seas/global-total claims. Use with empty areas and null landing buffers.

areas.description: Only actual documented regions/polygons. Do not invent an EEZ identifier.

definition.description: Source/justification and geographic meaning, not vessel flag

justification.description: Explain spatial resolution/coordinate precision and sensitivity; not a physical risk zone

snapshot_alignment_note.description: Explain whether activity years align with the documented infrastructure snapshot
